summary: Full backend + frontend testing of iPhone Settings Simulator MVP. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed (auth login/me, JWT no-exp claim, public GET /api/device, admin-protected PUT /api/device, IMEI check found/not-found/imei2/dash-strip, update+restore roundtrip). Frontend: 11/11 Playwright flows passed via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL - public IMEI check (found + not-found), Settings->General->About navigation with dynamic device data, admin login->dashboard, session persists across reload (localStorage admin_token), IMEI edit reflected in public checker, and IMEI restored to seeded 356789104532198. Only issue found: a naming inconsistency in a data-testid vs the review request.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid is 'imei-check-button' but review request/spec calls it 'imei-verify-button'. Test worked after using actual testid, but recommend aligning to avoid breaking downstream tests.

action_items: Optionally rename data-testid 'imei-check-button' -> 'imei-verify-button' in /app/frontend/src/pages/PublicImeiCheck.js to match the spec in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup(): when admin exists but password matches, no-op is fine; if password differs it updates hash - good (idempotent). Consider also handling case where env password matches to keep behavior explicit.
JWT has no exp claim as required, but there is no server-side revocation mechanism; acceptable for MVP but note that if secret leaks tokens are valid forever.
CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' fallback via env; browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. In production ensure CORS_ORIGINS is set to explicit origins.
get_device_doc returns full document including sensitive-looking identifiers on a public endpoint; acceptable because this is a simulator, but worth noting.
server.py is 272 lines - fine for now; consider splitting auth vs device routers if it grows.
seed_data_creation: None created. Verified seeded IMEI 356789104532198 and IMEI2 356789104532206. IMEI was temporarily changed to 356789104532777 during roundtrip test then restored back to 356789104532198.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend flows are stable. Only nit: data-testid mismatch on Verify button (imei-check-button vs imei-verify-button in spec).
